question.en: How was the drunk removed from the ring?
question.zh: 醉汉是怎么被弄出斗牛场的？

sentences.en: How was the drunk removed from the ring?
sentences.zh: 醉汉是怎么被弄出斗牛场的？

sentences.en: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
sentences.zh: 在一次斗牛时，一个醉汉突然溜达到斗牛场中央。

chunks.x: into the middle of the ring

sentences.en: but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
sentences.zh: 但醉汉没有意识到危险。

sentences.en: The bull was busy with the matador at the time,
sentences.zh: 当时公牛正对付斗牛士，

sentences.en: but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
sentences.zh: 但它突然看见了那个正说着粗话、挥舞红帽子的醉汉。

chunks.x: of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap

sentences.zh: 公牛显然对批评很敏感，

sentences.en: the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
sentences.zh: 它把斗牛士忘得一干二净，朝醉汉冲了过去。

sentences.en: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
sentences.zh: 然而醉汉似乎很有把握。

sentences.en: When the bull got close to him,
he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
sentences.zh: 他笨拙地闪到一边让公牛过去。

sentences.en: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
sentences.zh: 人群爆发出欢呼声，醉汉鞠了一躬。

sentences.en: By this time, however three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
sentences.zh: 不过这时已有三个人走进斗牛场，迅速把醉汉拖到了安全的地方。

sentences.en: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him,
sentences.zh: 连公牛似乎也为他感到遗憾，

sentences.en: for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
sentences.zh: 因为它同情地看着，直到醉汉被带走，才重新把注意力转向斗牛士。
